- United Kingdom generated £117.3k revenue in TW, representing 74.4% of total sales and ranking first among all countries.
- Total revenue across all countries reached £157.7k in TW, with 91,499 units sold across 337 orders.
- Netherlands achieved £18.0k revenue in TW with an exceptional WoW growth of 1414.9%, ranking second in performance.
- EIRE delivered £9.2k revenue in TW with a WoW increase of 61.3%, securing the third position.
- United Kingdom experienced a significant WoW decline of 30.4% in revenue, falling from £168.0k LW to £117.3k TW.
- Netherlands processed only 3 orders in TW despite strong revenue growth, while United Kingdom handled 314 orders.
- EIRE generated 5,000 units from 7 orders in TW, achieving an 11.4% share of total units sold.
